models.name: crash_classifier_v1
models.description: Character-level CNN trained on macOS/Windows crash log text. Input: first 512 chars of crash log, one-hot encoded over 128 ASCII chars. Output: IssueClass logits.

models.name: process_anomaly_v1
models.description: Extended Isolation Forest scoring per-process resource usage. Input: [cpu_pct, mem_mb, io_bytes_per_sec, process_age_hours, cpu_trend_5m]. Re-trained weekly from local SQLite history.

models.name: temporal_anomaly_v1
models.description: MiniPatch-TST Transformer (4L × 64d × 4-head) pre-trained via Masked Metric Modeling on synthetic OS telemetry. Input: 30-step × 35-feature FeatureSet window (see feature_extractor::TEMPORAL_FEATURE_NAMES). Output: per-IssueClass anomaly scores in [0,1]. Global score = max of per-class scores.
